gaps: 2018 ITA DII men: Apr 4, Apr 11, Apr 18, Apr 25 and May 16 (final) team rankings pages were never captured by the Wayback Machine (404); no other copy of the full Top 50 found.
2019 ITA DII men: May 29, 2019 final (post-NCAA) national team ranking — ITA's linked Google Drive PDF is deleted (404) and not archived.
2019-20 (season 2020): only three team lists were published (Jan 15 preseason, Feb 19, Apr 15 final after COVID cancellation) — not a gap, the season stopped.
2021 ITA DII: all 2021 lists are coaches' polls (Top 25, Top 50 from May 6); ITA published no computer rankings that season.
NAIA 2007-2017: the NAIA grid prints ranks only — no points and no receiving-votes lists, so points are null and receiving_votes empty.

NAIA grid anomalies (complete=false): 2007 Preseason missing No. 22, 2007 Poll 1 missing No. 19, 2014 Preseason and Poll 1 missing No. 25, 2015 Final missing No. 22, 2016 Poll 5 missing No. 23 — the ranks are absent from the source grid itself.
ITA fall (Nov/Dec) DII lists are singles/doubles/regional only; no fall national team ranking exists to include.
sources_tried: NAIA week-by-week coaches' poll grids (primary, ranks only): https://www.naia.org/sports/mten/Records/Week-by-Week_Polls_-_Men-s_Tennis.pdf and https://www.naia.org/sports/wten/Records/Week-by-Week_Polls_-_Women-s_Tennis.pdf (parsed by x-coordinate; 2007-2017 used)
NAIA poll news releases on naia.org via web.archive.org (primary, with points) — used to fill women's Final/Postseason columns that are misaligned in the NAIA grid PDF
ITA 2017-18 rankings pages on itatennis.com via web.archive.org (Oracle_ITA_Division_II_{Men|Women}_s_Collegiate_Tennis_Rankings/*National_Team_Rankings*.htm)
